The '''Randon Run''' was a trade route in the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It passed through the [[Chamble system/Legends|Chamble]], [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Messert system/Legends|Messert]], [[Phaseera system/Legends|Phaseera]], [[Rakhuuun system/Legends|Rakhuuun]], and [[Randon system/Legends|Randon systems]]. It passed through mainly the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]], except for the Phaseera system located in the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]]. The run also intersected with the [[Great Kashyyyk Branch/Legends|Great Kashyyyk Branch]], the [[Durkteel Loop/Legends|Durkteel Loop]] and [[Nightroad/Legends|Nightroad]] at [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Randon/Legends|Randon]] was also at its intersection with the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]], [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|Ootmian Pabol]], [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|Pabol Sleheyron]] and the [[Dauntless Run]].
